scheme_name: The Meghalaya Tribal Students’ Book Grant (Post-Matric Education)
description:
The Meghalaya Tribal Students’ Book Grant (Post-Matric Education) is a welfare scheme initiated by the Government of Meghalaya. 

The scheme was launched in the year 2015. 

It aims to provide financial assistance to tribal students pursuing post-matric education. 

The primary objective of this scheme is to enhance the educational opportunities for tribal students. 

The government recognizes the challenges faced by these students in accessing educational resources. 

The scheme specifically targets students from Scheduled Tribes in Meghalaya. 

One of the measurable targets of the scheme is to improve the literacy rate among tribal communities. 

The government aims to increase the enrollment of tribal students in higher education institutions. 

The scheme provides a book grant of ₹5,000 per academic year. 

This amount is intended to cover the cost of books and study materials. 

Eligible students can receive this grant for a maximum of three years. 

The grant is disbursed directly to the students' bank accounts. 

To be eligible for the book grant, students must belong to Scheduled Tribes. 

Students must be enrolled in recognized post-matric courses. 

These courses can include undergraduate and postgraduate programs. 

The scheme is applicable to students studying in both government and private institutions. 

The income limit for eligibility is set at ₹2.5 lakh per annum. 

Students must provide proof of their family income during the application process. 

The application process involves several steps. 

First, students must obtain the application form from the official website or designated offices. 

The application form requires personal details and educational qualifications. 

Students must attach documents such as caste certificates and income certificates. 

Once the application is completed, it must be submitted to the respective educational institution. 

The institution will verify the application and forward it to the concerned department. 

The verification process includes checking the eligibility criteria. 

Students can expect to receive the grant within two months of application approval. 

The disbursement of funds occurs at the beginning of each academic year. 

The Meghalaya Tribal Research Institute is the implementing authority for this scheme. 

The institute operates under the Department of Tribal Affairs, Government of Meghalaya. 

Students can contact the institute for assistance or inquiries. 

The contact number for the Meghalaya Tribal Research Institute is +91-364-250-2030. 

The email address for inquiries is tribalresearchmeghalaya@gmail.com. 

The scheme has seen a positive impact on the educational landscape for tribal students. 

In the year 2021, approximately 5,000 students benefited from the book grant. 

This number has steadily increased since the scheme's inception. 

The government has allocated a budget of ₹2 crore for the scheme in the financial year 2022-2023. 

This funding is aimed at supporting the growing number of applicants. 

The scheme is part of a broader initiative to promote education among tribal populations. 

The government also conducts awareness programs to inform students about the scheme. 

These programs are held in various districts across Meghalaya. 

The Meghalaya Tribal Students’ Book Grant is a crucial step towards educational equity. 

It addresses the financial barriers that tribal students face in accessing education. 

The scheme aligns with the National Policy on Education, which emphasizes inclusive education. 

The government is committed to ensuring that no tribal student is left behind. 

The scheme has also contributed to reducing dropout rates among tribal students. 

By providing financial support for books, students can focus on their studies. 

The initiative has received positive feedback from students and educational institutions alike. 

Many students have reported improved academic performance due to the support provided. 

The scheme is regularly reviewed to assess its effectiveness and impact. 

Feedback from beneficiaries is taken into account for future improvements. 

The Meghalaya Tribal Students’ Book Grant is an example of targeted welfare initiatives. 

It highlights the government's commitment to supporting marginalized communities. 

The scheme not only provides financial assistance but also empowers students. 

By facilitating access to educational resources, it fosters a culture of learning. 

The government encourages all eligible tribal students to apply for the grant. 

This initiative is a vital component of Meghalaya's educational development strategy. 

It reflects the state's dedication to uplifting tribal communities through education. 

The scheme continues to evolve in response to the needs of the students. 

The government remains focused on enhancing the quality of education in Meghalaya. 

Overall, the Meghalaya Tribal Students’ Book Grant (Post-Matric Education) is a significant welfare scheme. 

It plays a crucial role in promoting educational opportunities for tribal students in the state. 

The initiative is a testament to the government's efforts in ensuring educational equity. 

Students are encouraged to take advantage of this financial support. 

The scheme represents a commitment to building a brighter future for tribal youth. 

The impact of this initiative is expected to resonate for generations to come. 

By investing in education, the government is investing in the future of Meghalaya.
